text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's dusk, and Kitasan Black and I have just finished helping out the neighborhood association. We're strolling around town when…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Look at all those people over there… Do you think they're holding a festival or something?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa, a raffle! I love testing my luck with these!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait… We don't have any tickets since we didn't do any shopping…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oho, hey there, Kita! Thanks for pitchin' in with the association again today.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Tell you what. Here's a ticket, on the house. Go and have a spin.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yay! Did you hear that, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I guess one good turn does deserve another.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer! Let's spin this with all we've got! Heave ho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black and I take hold of the level and give it a good spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: YEEES! We did it, Trainer! We got the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A hot spring vacation! It'll be like an all-you-can-eat-and-relax fest!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, but… We can't accept this… It wouldn't be fair for everyone else since we won this with a free ticket.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: What're you two talkin' about? Have you any idea how much the neighborhood association owes you, Kita?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: And here you are, pullin' the grand prize! We're thrilled you got it! Go and have fun, y'hear?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well… if you insist! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's do as he says and accept the coupon. It'd be rude to refuse such kindness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we humbly accept the vacation coupon.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, it's not like we can start packing our bags right away. I mean, this year is just so important…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Not just for me, but for Dia, too. I can't be goofing off during such a critical time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Maybe after I've kept my promise with Dia and I feel like it's okay to use it to treat myself…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then maybe we can use it. What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Sounds like a plan! We'll have to work hard!
Sounds like a plan! We'll have to work hard!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: For sure! I'm going to make this year one for the history books! And once I do…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna soak all my troubles away in the hot spring! I'll hum my dad's best hits in the tub!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A relaxing soak is waiting for us on the other side of victory. Kitasan Black is bursting with joy and determination to claim that vacation!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Talk about an indulgent side dish!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's huge, too! We probably won't even need a pot for this, huh, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Uh… Why would we need a pot at all?
Uh… Why would we need a pot at all?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, I was just thinking, it's so big, we could share it with people family-style, just like you do with hot pot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nothing beats eating together! I always eat together with my dad's apprentices when I'm back home!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Since this steak is so big, why don't we invite people over to eat it with us? Like Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow, Kita! This steak is huge! Did a bunch of carrots rain from the sky for you to make this or something?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Of course not. Anyway, come on! Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us descend on the mammoth of a hamburger steak and have a great time!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Are you sure I can have all of these?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is a lot of carrots… This reminds me of the soup kitchen…
choice_data_list: Oh, I didn't know you volunteered there.
Oh, I didn't know you volunteered there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I do! I go there to help all the time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's always so nice to see people smiling and warming themselves up by the huge pot of stew on snowy days.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Their smiles will stay with me forever. Seeing them always makes me glad I went to help out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gah! There's no time to waste. Everyone is waiting for these carrots!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer! Let's hurry! There are hungry mouths to feed!
choice_data_list: Hold on! We're not on volunteer duty right now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, oops! Sorry, force of habit…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, let's take these back with us, then. We should share them with the others since we have so many!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When we get back, Kitasan Black makes carrot stew and shares it with everyone. They all thoroughly enjoy the nutritious meal.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh… Just one carrot, huh? That's kind of a letdown…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the anticlimactic finish, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I guess I didn't put enough spirit into it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hang on! I can hold a concert using this carrot as a microphone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll sing something special that I don't usually do in my winning concerts, like an enka song!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A single caaarrot! ♪ Hidden in the depths my sleeeve!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A truly inexplicable carrot-themed enka song echoes into the evening sky. We eat the carrot as a side dish at dinner afterward.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aw, rats… Just tissues. I'm sorry, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Things usually don't end up great when I act on impulse…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What should I have done differently? Maybe I should've spun the lever more gently…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Or maybe, instead of that, I should've spun it fast enough to make the handle snap right off!
choice_data_list: I feel like it's better to get tissues than to break the poor machine…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Weeell… I guess you have a point… But really? Just tissues?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's shoulders slump in disappointment over the lackluster result…
